appraisal_events.evidence: M. de Norpois posait ces questions à Bloch avec une véhémence qui, tout en intimidant mon camarade, le flattait aussi... Bloch était embarrassé pour répondre. M. de Norpois ne lui en laissa pas le temps.
appraisal_events.explanation: Norpois delivers a long, forceful political monologue addressed at Bloch as though he embodied an entire party, which flatters him even as it intimidates him and repeatedly denies him the chance to answer.

status_effects.explanation: Norpois dominates the exchange with an uninterrupted, elaborate political oration, never yielding the floor to Bloch.
Despite the flattering address, Bloch is left embarrassed and voiceless, unable to get a word in against Norpois's torrent of speech.
